summary: Google Play becomes the only native Android channel. The in-app APK updater (GitHub release check, download, staging, installer hand-off, banner, snackbar and the Settings Updates row) is removed, with REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES and the FileProvider that served staged APKs. mobile-release.yml builds a signed AAB, verifies package, version, upload-key signer and permissions, and uploads it to a Play test track.

desktop.reason: The desktop app and its electron-updater lane are unchanged. The Mobile pairing tab still links switchboard.tn07.dev/apk; it moves to the Play listing once that is live.

reactNativeIos.reason: The Expo client is the iOS app and keeps its OTA lane (mobile-ota.yml, --platform ios); only its AGENTS.md text about lanes changes.

sharedBackendApi.reason: The updater read GitHub releases directly; no backend or wire protocol was involved.

automated: ./gradlew testDebugUnitTest lintDebug bundleRelease assembleRelease compileDebugAndroidTestKotlin passes on this branch.
verify-android-apk.mjs --aab read the locally built AAB with bundletool 1.18.3 and keytool, listed its permissions and refused the throwaway signer.
aapt2 dump permissions on the release APK lists no REQUEST_INSTALL_PACKAGES.
notExercised: The workflow on GitHub Actions: it needs PLAY_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_JSON and a Play app record, which do not exist yet.
Starting the app on a device that holds updater state, to see the cleanup delete it.
